sfx_review.label: swoosh_reverse
sfx_review.note: Dense broadband swell building from ~12.12s and cutting off near 12.38s as the bar mark bursts into particles.

pattern.description: The waveform mark bursts into scattered particles inside a coloured glow while the camera pushes in; the particles drift and converge into two dotted point-cloud heads, and a tagged caption fades in below with the spoken words highlighted.
pattern.why_premium: A single continuous particle system carries the brand mark into the next idea (two speakers) without a cut; depth comes from blurred foreground bokeh and a slow push-in, and the caption highlight is word-synced to the voice.

build_hint.gsap: Timeline: scale the camera group 1 -> 1.1 (power1.inOut, 1.7s); emit N particles from the logo centre with x/y/scale tweens (power3.out, stagger {each: 0.004, from: 'center'}), then tween each to its target position in one of two head point-clouds (power2.inOut, 0.9s); background radial-gradient opacity 0 -> 1 -> 0.15 (sine.inOut); captions fromTo opacity 0 -> 1 (power2.out, 0.4s) with per-word color tweens timed to word starts.
build_hint.remotion: Per particle: progress = spring({frame: frame - delay_i, fps, config: {damping: 26, stiffness: 80}}); position = interpolate(progress, [0,1], [scatter_i, headTarget_i]); camera scale = interpolate(frame, [0, 50], [1, 1.1], {easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.quad)}); caption word colour switches at word.start_s * fps.

notes: Camera verdict is push_in. Small bokeh particles b08, b09, b12 and mouth dots b07/b10/b11 also drift but are omitted as minor. Caption highlight timing follows narration words 27-31.
